thread:
devon: Evening oncall handoff — I'm wrapping coverage for the nightly deploy. Main points: rolling deploy of route-service tonight at 02:00 UTC, 3-stage canary (5%/25%/100%), DB index backfill scheduled as low-priority job after rollout. Expect ~5-7% latency bump during stage 2. I'll be reachable until 22:30 PST.

sam: Thanks. Any freeze windows for config changes? Also is there a migration for embeddings table?

devon: Freeze for API schema and traffic shaping 01:30–03:30 UTC. Embeddings migration is not in this release — deferred. DB backfill touches route_logs only.

maria: I'll take primary monitoring for canaries. I'll set a PagerDuty rule at 4xx/5xx spike > 3min :eyes: 

kai: Can you drop the rollback command here and any smoke checks?

devon: Rollback quick: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/route-service -n prod` then `kubectl rollout status` to confirm. Smoke checks: 1) POST /v1/generate health prompts (10 qps) 2) Sampling of KV cache hit rate (>85%) 3) error-rate <0.5% over 5m.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @devon at 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z — canary steps created: canary-1 (5%), canary-2 (25%), full (100%). Link: <https://deploys.redwood.internal/route-service/1234>

sam: Noted. If canary shows latency >20% baseline or error >0.5% at stage 2, we'll pause and revert. Who has permission to escalate to infra?

maria: I'm primary escalation for infra for this window. @kai you'll be primary next-shift if I'm offline. I'll keep an eye on trace sampling and the rollout dashboard.

devon: Handover: I'm off after 22:30 PST. Maria primary until 02:30 UTC, Kai backup. If you need me for rollback I can hop on for 30m. Runbook: <https://wiki.redwood/ops/deploys#route-service> Thanks team :thumbsup:
